channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Michelle não vai à convenção do PL e só mandará vídeo para Flávio
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro will not attend the PL's national convention on July 25, 2026, in person, where Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential candidacy will be formalized. Instead, she will send a supportive video after publicly accepting Flávio's public apology, made one day prior, following weeks of estrangement over his comments about her role in PL Mulher. The reconciliation was brokered by Celina Leão, Damares Alves, and Rogério Marinho. Though her physical absence disappoints party leaders seeking a unity display, her video endorsement is seen as signaling continued campaign engagement, particularly in mobilizing female and conservative voters, as she runs for Senate in the DF.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula tem 48% e Flávio, 43% em 2º turno
item.description: A Datafolha poll released on July 24, 2026, shows President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leading the runoff scenario with 48% voting intention, compared to 43% for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ). The survey interviewed 2,004 people between July 22 and 23, with a 2-point margin of error and 95% confidence level. Registered with the TSE under BR-01166/2026, the study cost R$307,541.60 and was self-funded.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula tem 48% e Flávio Bolsonaro, 43%, no 2º turno
item.description: Lula leads the presidential race against Flávio Bolsonaro with 48% to 43% in a potential runoff, according to a July Datafolha poll, with a two-point margin of error. The results show stability compared to June, when Lula had 47% and Flávio 43%. Additional scenarios tested show Lula also leading against Ronaldo Caiado (48% to 40%) and Romeu Zema (48% to 40%).

item.title: A disputa no 2º turno entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro, em novo Datafolha
item.description: Lula leads Flávio Bolsonaro by 5 percentage points (48% to 43%) in a hypothetical runoff according to a Datafolha poll released July 24, 2026, with a margin of error of 2 percentage points. The president also leads over Ronaldo Caiado and Romeu Zema in other runoff scenarios, maintaining his advantage since the June poll.

item.title: Flávio usa IA com Milei para convocar apoiadores a convenção do PL
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) released an AI-generated video alongside Argentine President Javier Milei, calling supporters to the PL national convention in São Paulo where his presidential candidacy will be formalized. The video references 'Mission: Impossible', portraying Flávio as 'Fox Bravo' and Milei as an ally in the 'mission to free Brazil from the reds'. Milei arrived in São Paulo to attend the event, reinforcing ties with the Brazilian right and criticizing the Lula government.

item.title: Governo Lula vê pressão por big techs como influência eleitoral dos EUA
item.description: The Lula administration perceives pressure from U.S. Republican senators on Brazil’s digital platform regulation as an attempt to interfere in domestic political discourse, likening it to tactics used in prior trade disputes. A letter signed by 20 U.S. congressmen criticizes Brazil’s alignment with the EU’s Digital Markets Act and urges inclusion of the issue in bilateral trade negotiations. The Planalto rejects claims that the rules aim to control political content or harm foreign firms, stating their purpose is to combat abusive practices without stifling innovation.

item.title: Indígenas vão a Lula para tentar brecar dragagem acelerada do rio Tapajós
item.description: Indigenous leaders and social movement representatives met with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva at the Planalto Palace to request the suspension of the planned emergency dredging on the Tapajós River in Pará. They argue the project could cause environmental and social harm to traditional communities in the area.

item.title: Tarifas de Trump atingem 47,3% das exportações brasileiras para os EUA, diz governo
item.description: The Lula government estimates that 47.3% of Brazil's exports to the United States will be affected by the 12.5% tariffs announced by the Trump administration. This measure represents a significant impact on bilateral trade relations, particularly in sectors such as agribusiness and industry. The Brazilian government is evaluating diplomatic and commercial responses to mitigate the effects.

item.title: PL lança esposa de Alexandre Ramagem à Câmara dos Deputados
item.description: The PL party officially nominated Rebeca Ramagem, wife of former deputy Alexandre Ramagem, as its candidate for the Chamber of Deputies from Rio de Janeiro. Rebeca, a prosecutor from Roraima on leave, is campaigning while her husband, convicted by the STF to 16 years in prison for involvement in a coup plot and currently a fugitive in the U.S., faces a Brazilian extradition request. She claims to have been targeted after losing her remote work arrangement and having her salary suspended by the STF since December 2025.

item.title: Lula diz que Orçamento não cobre “da cabeça aos pés”
item.description: President Lula compared the Union Budget to an 'airplane blanket' that doesn't cover 'from head to toe', emphasizing insufficient resources to meet all needs. He announced a reduction in expenditure blocking from R$23.7 billion to R$17.9 billion in the 2026 budget, due to revised mandatory spending projections. He also defended government investment in education, rejecting the idea that public spending is merely a cost, and referenced his long-standing opposition to this view since 2003.

item.title: Valdemar diz que convidará Michelle de volta ao PL Mulher e espera que ela participe da campanha de Flávio
item.description: PL president Valdemar Costa Neto said he will invite Michelle Bolsonaro to return as head of PL Women, a position she resigned from last month. He hopes she will actively participate in Flávio Bolsonaro's 2026 election campaign.

item.title: Haddad diz que Tarcísio "não quer ganhar e vai perder" eleição em SP
item.description: PT's pre-candidate for São Paulo governor, Fernando Haddad, stated that current governor Tarcísio de Freitas 'does not want to win and will lose' the 2026 election, suggesting the Republican has already shown intent to leave office for another race. Haddad made the comment during the PDT's state convention, which formalized support for the Haddad-França ticket and endorsed Marina Silva and Simone Tebet for the Senate. The speech took place at the Franco Montoro Auditorium in Alesp, bringing together leaders from the PT, PSB, Rede, PSol, PV and PCdoB alliance.

item.title: IA: antes de convenção, Flávio "voa" com Milei em caças militares
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) released an AI-generated video showing him and Argentine President Javier Milei piloting jets decorated with the Brazilian and Argentine flags. The video includes references to threats like the 'Red Command' and criticisms of the Workers' Party (PT), with Milei stating that Brazil's border 'is a sieve' for drug trafficking. The clip was released ahead of the PL national convention, where Milei is expected to attend and speak to formalize Flávio's presidential candidacy.

item.title: PL aciona TSE contra ICL por divulgação de documentário sobre Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The PL party filed a complaint with the TSE against the ICL for publishing a documentary about Flavio Bolsonaro, alleging negative and premature electoral propaganda favoring President Lula. The party claims the material seeks to illegally influence the electoral process.

item.title: PDT confirma apoio a Haddad em São Paulo, mas quer indicar suplente ao Senado
item.description: The PDT has confirmed its support for Fernando Haddad (PT) in the São Paulo gubernatorial race but seeks to name a Senate substitute, advocating for Antônio Neto, president of the Central dos Sindicatos Brasileiros, to fill the seat should Marina Silva (Rede) or Simone Tebet (PSB) win Senate seats and return to the federal government under a potential fourth Lula term. Haddad has not committed to the name, stating the position is under negotiation, and is expected to formalize Márcio França (PSB) as his running mate for vice-governor on Saturday. The substitute decision will be made by August 4.

item.title: Enquanto Mendonça autoriza investigação do que Flávio não explica, ministros do STF seguem blindados
item.description: André Mendonça authorized an inquiry to investigate the flow of US$10.6 million raised by Flávio Bolsonaro for a Jair Bolsonaro biopic, suspected of money laundering and currency evasion. Flávio failed to account for the funds despite a 30-day commitment made on May 19, 2025, and invoices issued by his office to firms tied to false invoice schemes remain uncanceled, suggesting concealment. The case links to the vorcárica network, Havengate fund, and companies tied to individuals under investigation for tax fraud.

item.title: Defesa de Bolsonaro recorre contra proibição de visitas políticas
item.description: Bolsonaro's defense appealed to the Supreme Court against Justice Alexandre de Moraes' ruling banning politically motivated visits and manifesto dissemination, arguing it violates freedom of expression and lacks objective criteria. Lawyers contend that suspended political rights do not justify restricting the circulation of ideas and request Moraes to reconsider or the case be referred to the First Chamber. The ban, triggered by Flávio Bolsonaro's social media post of a letter from his father, remains in effect until the end of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Ibovespa desvaloriza mais de 1% devido a preocupações com cenário fiscal brasileiro
item.description: The Ibovespa fell 1.52% on Friday, closing at 174,000 points, driven by concerns over Brazil's fiscal outlook and the approaching 2026 electoral calendar, which is increasing market volatility. Bank stocks led the decline, with Banco do Brasil down 2.77%, followed by Bradesco, Santander, and Itaú. The dollar edged higher to 5.08 reais, while Brent crude retreated after surpassing $100 a barrel the previous day.

item.title: Fim da 6x1 precisa ocorrer antes da eleição, defende ala do governo Lula
item.description: Part of Lula's government believes the analysis of ending the 6x1 work schedule should occur after the 2026 presidential elections, while another faction advocates for a Senate vote in August, arguing that the window of opportunity for change closes with the election.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro e Milei
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro will attend the homage to Argentine President Javier Milei, who will receive the Order of the Ipiranga Collar, the highest honor awarded by the state of São Paulo, from Governor Tarcísio de Freitas at the Palácio dos Bandeirantes this morning. The article is exclusive to subscribers and requires registration for full access.

item.title: PL aciona o TSE contra a divulgação de documentário sobre Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The PL party filed a request with the TSE to halt the dissemination of the documentary 'Flávio Bolsonaro: the true story about the son of zero one', produced by Instituto Conhecimento Liberta, claiming it constitutes early negative electoral propaganda. The party alleges the institute used social media, WhatsApp groups, and paid media to promote the content before the legally permitted period, characterizing it as an abuse of economic and political power.

item.title: Flávio publica vídeo de IA com Milei: “A fronteira de vocês é uma peneira”
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) published an AI-generated video showing a Brazilian jet meeting an Argentine one, with the caption 'Your border is a sieve', in reference to the PL's national convention in São Paulo, which will feature Argentine President Javier Milei. The video was shared on Friday, May 24, as part of the party's mobilization for the event.

item.title: Indicação de assessor de Haddad para suplência de Tebet teve benção de caciques do PSB
item.description: The nomination of Laio Moraes, a close advisor to Fernando Haddad, as Simone Tebet's Senate substitute received backing from PSB leaders, including Geraldo Alckmin and João Campos. The decision will be formalized at the PT's São Paulo convention this Saturday (25), with Lula in attendance. Moraes served as Haddad's chief of staff at the Ministry of Finance and participated in strategic meetings to shape the left-wing ticket in São Paulo.

item.title: Lula defende que projetos científicos com 'sustentação' possam ser excluídos do arcabouço
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva urged researchers to develop science and technology projects robust enough to justify their exclusion from the fiscal framework, arguing that scientific sustainability should be strong enough to warrant differentiated treatment in the public budget.

item.title: Após reconciliação com Flávio, PL espera participação de Michelle por vídeo na convenção que lançará senador ao Planalto
item.description: The PL leadership expects Michelle Bolsonaro to participate via video at the national convention that will formally launch Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential candidacy, as a gesture of reconciliation after a family rift. Her remote appearance aims to reduce tensions and reinforce the image of bolsonarist unity, with Flávio also set to name her explicitly in his speech. The strategy follows her remote participation in the Rio state convention, where she relayed a message from Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Planalto minimiza reconciliação de Flávio e Michelle e ainda enxerga fissuras em campanha do rival
item.description: Allies of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva downplay the reconciliation between Flávio Bolsonaro and Michelle Bolsonaro, asserting that deep fissures remain in the PL pre-candidate’s presidential campaign. They argue that the reconciliation is insufficient to outweigh other negative factors, including Flávio’s ties to Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master and his role in the new tariff hike, which could undermine support among female and evangelical voters.

item.title: Lula decide não ir à posse de direitistas no Peru e na Colômbia
item.description: Lula decided not to attend the inaugurations of Keiko Fujimori in Peru and Abelardo de la Espriella in Colombia, prioritizing domestic commitments and campaign agenda. Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira will represent Brazil at Fujimori’s inauguration, while Colombian representation remains undefined. Despite his absence, Lula has already congratulated both elected leaders and maintains a pragmatic evaluation of relations with the new right-wing leaders in South America.

item.title: PDT confirma apoio a Haddad em convenção estadual em SP
item.description: The PDT confirmed its support for Fernando Haddad (PT) in the 2026 São Paulo gubernatorial race during a state convention. It also endorsed Marina Silva (Rede) and Simone Tebet (PSB) for the Senate, naming Antonio Neto and Marcelo Barbieri as their respective alternates. The party fielded 60 candidates for the Chamber of Deputies and 45 for the São Paulo State Assembly.

item.title: O novo apelo de Bolsonaro a Moraes para derrubar proibição de visitas eleitorais
item.description: The defense of Jair Bolsonaro appealed to Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes to overturn the ban on political-electoral visits and the dissemination of manifestos at his residence, where he is serving house arrest. Moraes' decision followed a live broadcast in which Bolsonaro's son Flávio read a letter from the former president, which the justice deemed a misuse of visitation rights. The defense argues that the loss of political rights does not justify restrictions on freedom of expression and requests a collegial review by the First Chamber.

item.title: Advogado de Lulinha reage a Flávio e cobra explicações sobre Master
item.description: The lawyer for Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) denied allegations by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro regarding an alleged R$ 300,000 monthly payment linked to INSS fraud, stating that Lulinha has already provided all necessary explanations to the STF, including banking and fiscal documents, and that the claim was dismissed by the Federal Police due to lack of evidence. The defense emphasized the accusation originated from an unverified account and that Lulinha was never indicted in the investigation. The lawyer also accused Flávio Bolsonaro of exploiting the issue during election season, calling the claims repeated falsehoods.

item.title: Renan aciona PF após cantora dizer que deseja vê-lo “cada vez mais morto”
item.description: Renan Santos, president of Missão and a presidential candidate, filed a complaint with the Federal Police after singer Sophia Chablau stated during a São Paulo concert that she wishes to see him 'increasingly dead'. His team deemed the remark a threat and incitement to violence. The case has been referred to the PF for investigation into potential offenses including threats and defamation.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula se encontra com líderes do sistema de ciência e tecnologia
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva meets on Friday morning (July 24, 2026) with leaders of Brazil's national science and technology system at the SBPC headquarters in São Paulo. The meeting, scheduled for 2 p.m., includes the participation of Ministers Luciana Santos (Science, Technology and Innovation) and Leonardo Barchini (Education).

item.title: Governo Lula avalia aplicar reciprocidade aos EUA só após a eleição
item.description: The Lula government decided not to apply the Economic Reciprocity Law against the United States before the October 2026 elections, prioritizing technical studies and negotiations with affected sectors. The measure was only 'triggered' (mechanism activated), not 'implemented' (tariff applied), and both countries should await the election results before defining next steps in bilateral relations.

item.title: Defesa de Bolsonaro reclama ao STF que restrição de visitas é silenciamento político
item.description: The defense of Jair Bolsonaro has complained to the STF that the ban on receiving visits for political-electoral purposes during his house arrest constitutes political silencing and ideological limitation of his 2026 election campaign. Lawyers argue the restriction, imposed by Minister Alexandre de Moraes after Bolsonaro's letter was read by his son Flávio on social media, is disproportionate and exceeds the 2022 coup attempt conviction, citing precedents like Lula's 2018 case when similar communications were allowed.

item.title: Defesa de Bolsonaro recorre contra proibição de visitas com fins político-eleitorais e divulgação de manifestos
item.description: Bolsonaro's defense appealed to the Supreme Federal Court against the ban on visits for political-electoral purposes and the dissemination of manifestos, arguing the measure is overly broad, unconstitutional, and lacks legal basis. Lawyers drew a parallel to Lula's 2018 situation, asserting that suspended political rights do not restrict freedom of expression, and requested that Alexandre de Moraes reverse the decision or refer it to the First Chamber of the Court.

item.title: Bolsonaro recorre de proibição a divulgação de manifestos políticos após decisão de Moraes sobre carta
item.description: Bolsonaro's defense appealed to the STF against the ban on publishing political-electoral manifestos, claiming it violates freedom of expression and thought. Lawyers argue the restriction constitutes prior censorship and cite Lula's case, who, while imprisoned, released a letter endorsing Haddad as successor without penalty. They also invoke Moraes' own doctrine on freedom-responsibility, asserting that any abuse of expression should be punished afterward, not through preemptive suppression.

item.title: Apesar de ameaça, governo Lula deve protelar reciprocidade contra produtos americanos após novo tarifaço
item.description: The Lula government announced it will activate the Reciprocity Law in response to new U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods, but will not immediately impose retaliatory taxes, delaying action until after the October elections to avoid economic harm. The move is seen as a negotiating tactic to pressure the U.S., with the government prioritizing dialogue and consultation with productive sectors, which oppose reciprocity due to fears of negative economic impacts.

item.title: “O Trump apoia o Flávio”, diz Boulos
item.description: Minister Guilherme Boulos claimed that U.S. President Donald Trump supports the presidential candidacy of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). He stated that Flávio traveled to the United States to offer Brazil's rare earth minerals to the Trump administration. Boulos contrasted this with his political opponent's stance.

item.title: Defesa de Bolsonaro apresenta recurso contra proibição de visitas político-eleitorais
item.description: The defense of former President Jair Bolsonaro (PL) filed a petition with the STF against the ban on politically motivated visits imposed by Minister Alexandre de Moraes, arguing the measure infringes on rights despite the suspension of his political rights. The petition, submitted as a regimental appeal, seeks to overturn the court order restricting electoral-related contacts until the end of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Bolsonaro cita Lula para derrubar restrições impostas por Moraes
item.description: Bolsonaro's defense appealed to the STF using Lula's case as precedent to overturn restrictions imposed by Moraes, arguing that suspension of political rights does not authorize banning political-electoral visits or third-party dissemination of manifestos. They cite that Lula had political letters read publicly and received 18 visits while imprisoned, without being deemed incompatible with the sentence regime. They request Moraes to review the decision or elevate the appeal to the STF's First Chamber.

item.title: EUA pode adotar medidas para pressionar Brasil contra PL das big techs
item.description: U.S. Republican lawmakers urged the Trump administration to take action against Brazil if it advances Bill 4.675/2025, which would regulate big techs modeled after the EU's Digital Markets Act. They claim the proposal unfairly targets American tech firms and reference the ongoing Section 301 USTR investigation as a backdrop to rising trade tensions.

item.title: Governo Lula monitora a visita de Milei e prepara reação a ataques em convenção do PL
item.description: The Lula government is closely monitoring the visit of Argentine President Javier Milei to Brazil, where he will attend the PL convention that will formalize Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential candidacy. While his participation is seen as normal, the Planalto is preparing an official response if Milei or his allies attack Brazil’s electronic voting system or electoral institutions, which they view as part of an international far-right strategy to undermine election credibility. Concerns have grown following statements by U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio and speeches by Bolsonaro allies who have previously falsely claimed the electronic voting system is insecure.

item.title: Lupi classifica como 'descortesia' ausência de Kalil na convenção nacional do PDT com Lula
item.description: The national president of the PDT, Carlos Lupi, labeled Alexandre Kalil's absence from the party's national convention in Brasília — where Lula received official backing for his re-election — as an act of 'discourtesy'. Kalil, former mayor of Belo Horizonte and pre-candidate for governor of Minas Gerais, avoided the event due to his reluctance to share a ticket with the PT, both nationally and in his state. Lupi stated Kalil feels 'deeply hurt' by Lula's preference for Senator Rodrigo Pacheco (PSB) as the Minas Gerais candidate and reiterated Kalil's stance of running independently, rejecting any rapprochement with the Workers' Party.

item.title: Sakamoto: Houve trégua entre Flávio e Michelle, mas não pacificação
item.description: The reconciliation video between Flávio Bolsonaro and Michelle Bolsonaro signals at most a temporary truce, not a definitive pacification, according to columnist Leonardo Sakamoto on UOL News. Despite the gesture of rapprochement, tensions between them persist and have not been fully resolved.

item.title: França critica privatizações de Tarcísio: "Ele foi servidor público"
item.description: At the PDT state convention, former minister Márcio França criticized Governor Tarcísio de Freitas's privatization policies, noting that Tarcísio has spent his entire career as a public servant and lacks private-sector experience to claim private management is inherently superior. França pointed to issues with Sabesp and the Metro Line 5-Lilás as examples of failed concessions, arguing that even if privatization is pursued, it must be done competently.

item.title: As tensões que antecedem a convenção de Flávio Bolsonaro em São Paulo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro criticizes Tarcísio de Freitas for lacking support in the pre-campaign, claiming the São Paulo governor is not doing enough and even showing sympathy toward rivals like Ronaldo Caiado, creating tension within Bolsonarismo. Despite the strain, the party convention this weekend may ease the conflict or at least project unity. The Lula vs. Flávio Bolsonaro race will likely be decided by undecided voters.

item.title: Imerso em crises, Flávio Bolsonaro se escora na polarização para chegar ao 2º turno
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL’s pre-candidate for president, is trying to consolidate his leadership by calling for unity and obedience to his father Jair Bolsonaro’s command amid internal crises, including a rift with Michelle Bolsonaro and disagreements over state candidacies. His trip to the U.S. to ask Trump to delay new tariffs on Brazil was poorly received and boosted Lula’s sovereignty narrative, who leads in polls. Despite his efforts, Flávio has not yet united the Bolsonarist base as his father once did.

item.title: Renan Santos aciona PF após artista dizer que o quer 'cada vez mais morto'
item.description: The presidential campaign of Renan Santos, candidate from the Missão party, filed a complaint with the Federal Police after an artist stated during a show in São Paulo last Wednesday (22) that she wishes he were 'more and more dead'. The campaign team deemed the statement a threat and requested an investigation.

item.title: Google registra boom nas buscas por voto em trânsito e alta do interesse pelo voto feminino
item.description: Brazilian interest in voting information surged 50% in the last seven days, driven by the opening of the absentee voting application period. Google Trends data shows a spike in searches for absentee voting and growing attention to women's voting participation, just ahead of the 2026 electoral campaign.

item.title: Mesmo com petróleo perto de US$ 100, governo não prevê retomada de subsídio do diesel de R$ 0,35
item.description: The Lula government does not currently plan to reinstate the R$ 0.35 per liter diesel subsidy, even with oil prices near $100, as it continues to maintain a R$ 1.12 per liter subsidy costing R$ 5.5 billion monthly. The decision reflects a fiscal smoothing strategy, as the previous subsidy was halted in June amid hopes of a Middle East ceasefire that did not materialize.
